# cpanel_directory_index (Resource)

Manages directory indexing for an existing directory in a cPanel account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_directory_index" "downloads" {
  directory = "public_html/downloads"
  type      = "disabled"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory` (String) The normalized directory path relative to the cPanel account home.
- `type` (String) The directory indexing mode: `inherit`, `disabled`, `standard`, or `fancy`.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_directory` (String) The absolute directory path reported by cPanel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_directory_index.downloads public_html/downloads
```
